title: Robotics foundations: quick quiz
description: Five questions about robot systems, sensors, motor drivers and control.

questions.explanation: A sensor provides information about the environment or the robot itself.

questions.prompt: Which part usually executes the robot control program?
questions.explanation: The controller runs the logic, processes sensor readings and commands actuators.

questions.prompt: What is feedback in a control system?
choices: A measurement of the system output
questions.explanation: Feedback is a measurement of what actually happened, used to correct future commands.

questions.prompt: Why is a motor driver often necessary?
choices: To safely switch and control motor power
questions.explanation: A microcontroller pin usually cannot provide the required motor current directly.

questions.prompt: Which is the best first step in designing a robot?
choices: Write down requirements and a system diagram
questions.explanation: Requirements and a block diagram clarify the subsystems and constraints before spending time and money.
